data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable data observed in the canonical data directory.

budget.rationale: The canonical data directory measured 531929133 bytes on 2026-11-21; 768MiB leaves roughly 44% headroom for normal component-test evidence growth while retaining a binding ceiling.

gate_evidence.rationale: Gate ledgers, stamp reports, and baseline captures are durable recorded verdicts; 1212269 bytes were measured on 2026-08-27.

budget.rationale: The durable gate cohort measured 1212269 bytes on 2026-08-27; 256 MiB allows long-lived verdict history without authorizing deletion.

retention.rationale: Retention receipts are durable records of cleanup decisions and enforcement outcomes.

budget.rationale: Retention receipts are bounded JSON records and must remain durable for auditability.

retired.rationale: Cold release source is retained in the component data root's .retired archive for immutable-version recovery until the governed reaper's retention window expires.

budget.rationale: The retired source tier is currently about 19MiB; the ceiling bounds cold history while leaving room for normal release turnover.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces include component data and durable gate evidence in the scenario state class.

service.name: react-component-library
service.description: Central UI for designing, previewing, editing, and tracking shared React UI components across Vrooli scenarios.

ai-gateway.description: Local-only structured inference for explicit Ask requests over the indexed workbench results.
ai-gateway.degraded_behavior: Lexical and semantic retrieval remain available; explicit Ask requests report that answer generation is unavailable.

agent-manager.description: Optional server-side dispatcher for attributable assisted extraction and adoption workflows; direct RCL APIs remain available when it is unavailable.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Assisted extraction and adoption workflows remain unavailable and are stored as unavailable; direct catalog and adoption APIs remain available.

experience-manager.description: Provides the shared experience-spec contract and capture reconciliation used by RCL experience evidence.
experience-manager.degraded_behavior: Catalog, component contracts, and direct library APIs remain available; experience capture and reconciliation are unavailable until experience-manager is healthy.

ui-health.description: Provides the shared UI inventory and provenance contracts used by RCL inventory adapters.
ui-health.degraded_behavior: Catalog and component APIs remain available; cross-scenario UI inventory integration is unavailable until ui-health is healthy.

search-hub.description: Optional federated search registry for RCL's workbench provider descriptor and evaluation corpus.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: RCL continues serving local FTS and semantic search; provider self-registration retries only during startup and resumes on the next boot.

code-facts.description: Supplies the shared parsed TypeScript import graph required by the blocking graph-reconciled catalog gate.
code-facts.degraded_behavior: API startup is blocked until code-facts is healthy because the graph-reconciled catalog gate cannot safely pass without its import graph.

brand-manager.description: Optional brand assignments and token contract used by the RCL catalog and preview surfaces.
brand-manager.degraded_behavior: The library remains available with its built-in neutral brand; assigned brand metadata and brand-specific token previews are unavailable.

browser-automation-studio.description: Optional authenticated browser capture provider for component and workspace evidence.
browser-automation-studio.degraded_behavior: Manual and static workflows remain available; authenticated captures and live visual evidence report unavailable.

image-tools.description: Optional image comparison and generated-reference provider for visual workspace review.
image-tools.degraded_behavior: Stored screenshots and workspace editing remain available; generated references, heatmaps, and visual comparisons report unavailable.

qdrant.description: Optional vector store for semantic retrieval over the workbench search projection.
qdrant.degraded_behavior: SQLite FTS continues to serve keyword search; semantic retrieval reports degraded until Qdrant is available.

ollama.description: Local embedding role used by ai-go/search through the Ollama resource gateway.
ollama.degraded_behavior: SQLite FTS continues to serve search; semantic retrieval reports degraded until embeddings are available.
